name: Storage Limit
description: The Coin Locker expands to {{slots:comma}} instead of 2,000. Two optional parts change how many slots each purchase adds and what it costs.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Coin Locker slots
settings.help: Stock is 2,000. It cannot go lower, so nothing already stored is stranded. Capped at 20,000 (10x stock) - no similar count/slot field anywhere in the stock game goes anywhere near as high as the old 99,999 ceiling did.

settings.label: Slots per purchase
settings.help: Stock is 10, so filling a 10,000-slot locker means buying the expansion a thousand times. At 100 it is a hundred times; at 1,000 it is ten. Only used while the 'Slots per purchase' part is ticked.

settings.label: Price per purchase
settings.help: The game lists two prices for this one expansion - 10,000 KC and 1,000 KC - and this sets both, since which one you are charged is decided in code rather than in the database. Roughly cost-neutral is 100 KC per slot, so 100 slots a purchase balances at 10,000. Capped at 200,000 - the highest this same price field is ever set to anywhere in the stock game. Only used while the 'Price per purchase' part is ticked.

patches.description: Each purchase adds {{per_buy:comma}} slots instead of 10
